card.name: Overdose treatment and corrective measures
card.fires_on: Commas in lists of treatments in overdose sections, and words like corrective, such, or cause that lead into a remedial action. It appears where the text says what to do about an overdose or abnormal result.

modes.label: Commas in treatment lists
modes.description: Comma after an item in a list of supportive treatments or drugs for overdose.
modes.example: Treatment should consist of gastric lavage, emetics<<,>> and activated charcoal.

modes.label: Lead-in to corrective action
modes.description: Words such as corrective, such or cause that introduce a remedy or an investigation.
modes.example: Institute<< corrective>> measures such as administration of exogenous insulin

modes.label: Investigating cause
modes.description: The word cause after investigate the probable, for abnormal liver tests.
modes.example: investigate the probable<< cause>>, treat (if possible) and follow
